adversarialFindings.description: The UX/UU layout helper uses headerLines.every(...), which passes for an empty array and does not require both expected elements. A future markup/selector change could silently remove part of this regression oracle.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Accepted minor test-hardening opportunity. Current MicroShell always renders the close control, RpgButton supplies its selected text span, and progress renders the selected small counter. Explicit close/keyboard navigation checks, before/after images, the demonstrated pre-fix failure and passing post-fix journeys establish this correction. A future count assertion would strengthen regression detection; no current missing control or layout defect was established. No test or product edit is needed for this candidate.
